item.text:
It provides order helpers: calculate line-item totals, apply discount codes, compute an average, and format an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` uses `i <= items.length`; at `i === items.length`, `items[i]` is `undefined`, so every call crashes. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides a quantity-adjusted total by the number of lines, not total units. Its result is wrong when quantities exceed 1.
- For an empty item list, `averageItemPrice` would return `NaN` after fixing `calcTotal`; it needs an empty-list policy.
